- Cold-chain logistics in 2026: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data (blog.halvorsen.example/2026/cold-chain).
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/cold-chain/companion): cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
